title: Universal induction sets the chance of the next state

statements.text: The one postulate: being in self state $x$ now, there is an objective chance of being in self state $y$ next, and its value is the one a universal method of induction assigns. In the bit model this is Solomonoff induction, an algorithmic prior over the next bit.

sources.quote: It is based on a single postulate: that universal induction determines the chances of what any observer sees next.
The mathematical structure that defines its value formalizes a universal method M of induction.
